description: Build a direct UNPKG file URL (the original file lookup) with a deliberate version policy, verifying the file exists when a path is given.

file.description: File path inside the package. Defaults to the resolved entry point.

policy.description: preserve: keep the given spec (default). exact: resolved version. patch: major.minor (bug fixes flow). range: ^major.minor.patch.

subpath.description: Package subpath import, e.g. hooks for preact/hooks. Resolved through the exports map, then file discovery. Ignored when file is given.

version.description: Exact version, dist-tag, or range to resolve. Defaults to latest.

name: build_file_url
title: Build a canonical UNPKG file URL
